notes.key_messages:
Candidates should read the questions carefully, making sure that they answer them fully. The appropriate
degree of accuracy should be used and candidates should also check that they have their calculators in the
correct mode for the question they are doing.
notes.general_comments:
A basic lack of understanding of logarithms appeared to be quite common among many candidates. This
clearly affected their performance on both Questions 1 and 2.
